• Written in Rust and GPUI rendered at 120+ FPS for blistering fast performance
• Native multiplayer live-collaborative editing built into the core editor

THE BAD & PRICING:
• Smaller extension ecosystem compared to VS Code
• Model: Free / Open Source
scenes.voiceover_script: On the flip side, keep in mind that smaller extension ecosystem compared to vs code. As for pricing, it's structured as 100% Free open source code editor; opt-in paid team collaboration features planned..
